main_result.statement: For a Parseval frame in R^3 with maximum leverage alpha<1/3, a physical-index bipartition exists with determinant product at least (1-3alpha)/64. In the heavy-null normalized complement this yields Pi_3 cross product at least D(1-c)sqrt(1-3alpha)/8 and hence the exact-cross-rank density bound. At alpha<=1/4, D>=1/2, c<=61/64 the density bound is <71.805.

secondary_result.statement: For ell_j>1/4, either ||z||^2>1/8 and the exact O3 completion mass through {0,j} is D c ||z||^2>7/144, or the normalized longitudinal mass exceeds 1/8, which can happen for at most seven rows. Applying account03/B19 r19 leaves any unpaid transverse row with |A_jj|<1/256 and |A_0j|<sqrt(5)/128 while retaining O3 mass >7/144.

compatible_new_result.effect: pays c=1 exact null-coloop endpoint; leaves punctured 61/64<c<1

first_unpaid_detail: Pay c<=61/64 with max normalized leverage>1/4 after partner exits, where survivors are a <=7-row longitudinal-heavy core or explicit double-near-null/O3 packets, or pay the punctured near-unit chamber 61/64<c<1. Arbitrary additional spectrum remains separate.
